v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Secúndum multitúdinem * miseratiónum tuárum, Dómine, dele iniquitátem meam.
text.en: O Lord, according to the multitude of thy tender mercies, * blot out my transgressions.

text.la: Deus meus es tu, * et confitébor tibi: Deus meus es tu, et exaltábo te.
text.en: Thou art my God, * and I will praise thee; Thou art my God, and I will exalt thee.

text.la: Ad te de luce * vígilo, Deus, ut vídeam virtútem tuam.
text.en: O God, early will I seek thee, * to see thy power.

text.la: Hymnum dícite, * et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
text.en: Sing praises, * and exalt Him above all for ever.

text.la: Omnes Angeli * eius laudáte Dóminum de cælis.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * from the heavens, all His angels.

text.la: Fratres: Si linguis hóminum loquar, et Angelórum, caritátem autem non hábeam, factus sum velut æs sonans, aut cýmbalum tínniens.
text.en: Brothers: If I speak with the tongues of men, and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

v.en: Lord, thou hast been our refuge.

text.la: Ecce ascéndimus * Ierosólymam, et consummabúntur ómnia quæ scripta sunt de Fílio hóminis: tradétur enim géntibus, et illudétur, et conspuétur: et postquam flagelláverint, occídent eum, et tértia die resúrget.
text.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, * and all things that are written by the Prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished; for He shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked and spitted on; and they shall scourge Him, and put Him to death, and the third day He shall rise again.

text.la: Preces nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: atque, a peccatórum vínculis absolútos, ab omni nos adversitáte custódi.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech You, mercifully hear our prayers; loose us from the chains of our sins and keep us from all adversity.
